verdict.rationale: cubic's own codebase-scan feature deploys thousands of AI agents across a repository, which is a vendor-orchestrated parallel fleet. However, it serves a single purpose (finding bugs and vulnerabilities), not user-directed, distinct tasks. The longest documented run is Ultrareview at about 30 minutes, with no evidence of agents running autonomously for hours or days. missing for 10: user-launched fleets assigned to different arbitrary tasks, documented multi-hour/multi-day autonomous runs, fleet management or monitoring, independent corroboration

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can launch fleets of autonomous agents that work in parallel on different tasks for hours or days

citations.quote: Codebase scans deploy thousands of AI agents to find bugs and vulnerabilities across your repository.
It runs a longer, multi-pass analysis using cubic's most capable review models, and typically takes around 30 minutes.
